description: This file defines a function for seeding initial data into a database for development purposes. It performs idempotent operations such as upserting feature flags, creating a demo user with associated profile and inventory item, and logs the process.

classes.name: FeatureFlag
classes.description: Data model representing feature flags in the database.

classes.name: FeatureFlagScope
classes.description: Enum or constant for feature flag scope types.

classes.name: InventoryItem
classes.description: Data model representing inventory items in the database.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Data model representing user profile information.

methods.name: None seed_initial_data(session: AsyncSession)
methods.description: Asynchronously seeds baseline data, including feature flags and demo user, into the database.
